theme: Handoff day — the girls come to you and the road bends toward Orlando.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar is clear until mid-afternoon, then it's the 3 PM pickup and the drive to the Orlando villa. Use the quiet morning before the six-of-you logistics take over.

needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV (p1, open since early Sept) needs to be booked before the 3 PM pickup and the drive south — don't do it walk-up with four kids in tow.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets for the 26th–27th
needsAttention.detail: Tickets are the only open item left for the Disney weekend — six people; verify on the Disney site whether your ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas sells out early — book it refundable now, since the Pathfinder heads south in October and won't be up north.

schedule.title: School pickup — all four girls

schedule.title: Drive to the Orlando villa
